bangladesh_calendar_contract.note: A record dated by a Bangladesh calendar day is not in the future when its date is on or before the Asia/Dhaka (UTC+6, no DST) calendar date of the instant it was captured. EconDelta's aggregate runs about 02:56 BDT, still the previous UTC day, so comparing such a date with a UTC date wrongly rejects the day's reading. `sources` lists the producer sources whose dates are Bangladesh calendar days: bb_forex (the scraper's date.today() on the Dhaka box; reserves use BB's month end), dse_market (the DSE page's own trading date) and auction_results (BB auction dates). Everything else keeps the UTC comparison: commodity_prices quote dates come from exchange price history (not Bangladesh-local); v3 registry records name only their indicator id as source, so their publisher and date basis are not carried; writer confirmations are dated by the UTC date prefix of the parse capture. Each case gives the producer run instant (`aggregate_now`), The Brief's 08:00 BDT publish date (`brief_today`) and the verdict both repositories must reach. Values are copied from builder_binding_contract; only dates and instants are synthetic boundary inputs. R2 G1 adds the 02:56 BDT run on the first Bangladesh day of a month (1 Oct), of the Bangladesh fiscal year (1 Jul), of a calendar year (1 Jan) and on/after a leap day (29 Feb / 1 Mar 2028): each is still the previous UTC day, so each boundary has the accepted Dhaka day and the refused next day. Dates synthetic; value from the real run.

upstream_liveness_contract.note: R2 fix 5. Upstream CPI/M2 source-poll liveness, from EconDelta's E6 monthly source-poll receipts (utils/monthly_evidence.source_monitor), is published in latest.json sources_status under these keys. The CPI/M2 monthly legs derive from EconDelta's own daily table, so their database reread proves nothing about the upstream Bangladesh Bank jobs: only a typed upstream-source receipt checked within the existing 26-hour job-check window is ok. These entries never raise EconDelta's 'sources not OK' alert (decision j); The Brief reads a non-ok entry as a degraded reason naming the family.

live_upstream_polls.scenario: R2 fix H3. EconDelta's daily fetch stage (econdelta-fetch.timer, 01:10 BDT) polled every CPI/M2 upstream page at 2026-09-24T19:10:00Z and read each page's own vintage (general_inflation, food_inflation, non_food_inflation, m2_growth_yoy_pct); it wrote one typed upstream-poll receipt per page in data/upstream_polls/, a namespace the monthly legs' database rereads never write.
